sections.heading: Welcome aboard Ventura
sections.body: Welcome to the independent Elevor360D Ventura Cruise Companion. This page can be updated using your private manager app. Check official P&O Cruises information for current facilities, deck locations and schedules.

sections.heading: Using the Ventura deck guide
sections.body: The venue directory lists well-known Ventura venues. Deck numbers are deliberately marked for verification until checked against the current official P&O Cruises Ventura deck plan. You can add your own deck notes inside the app.

sections.heading: Before sailing
sections.body: Check your cruise booking and official P&O Cruises communications for embarkation times, itinerary changes, onboard bookings, dining availability and current ship facilities.

sections.heading: Share this free guide
sections.body: Open Share App in the menu to show the Ventura-specific QR code. It links to https://elevor360.github.io/Ventura-Cruise-app/.
